mandatory_gates_in_order: The candidate is one maximal nonempty main_bars ambiguous run with the exact ordinary-reader reason; unreadable frames are never redraws.
The authenticated recording-wide maximum source interval is retained exactly and is no greater than the 1 s sanity ceiling; it does not loosen a candidate chain.

Two immediate readable support frames precede and follow the run, with consecutive video and source indices and every capture gap no greater than the smaller of the verified recording-wide maximum and the fixed 10 ms support-chain maximum.
The nearest endpoints span no more than one 50 ms display update plus that effective support-chain interval bound.
One identical ready singleton previous/current main-bar expectation covers the support chain and matches stable oriented endpoint counts which differ by exactly one.
The fixed expectation-blind probe reproduces all six ordinary-reader fill diagnostics and retains the declared six 4 by 4 max-channel-median profiles.
Only the changing boundary cell is partial in every run frame; the other five cells remain definite, contiguous, and in their common endpoint states.
The changed-cell endpoint separation is at least 20 RMS; every run profile projects within -0.05 through 1.05 with normalized residual at most 0.15.
The projected path has no backward step over 0.05 and no more than 0.10 total backward motion; its raw median reverses by no more than two intensity levels.
Every unchanged cell has full-chain profile diameter at most 8 RMS.
The record affects main_bars only, changes no raw observation, and is usable only through an exact product-policy allowlist entry.

scope.claim: A maximal raw main-bar refusal is a coherent captured redraw between stable adjacent counts.
does_not_claim: a value for any ambiguous frame

validation.observer_eligibility_rule: COHERENT_SINGLE_BOUNDARY_ADJACENT_REDRAW with BOTH_CLEAR endpoints, NO extra-cell motion, and HIGH confidence
